1 MEDIUM1 INFO
Severity Category Message & Details
MEDIUM Compression 9 uncompressed textures = 118 MB — consider BC1/BC3/BC7 9 textures are uncompressed and using 118 MB together. Using BC1 (for opaque textures) or BC3/BC7 (for textures with transparency or fine detail) would reduce this significantly.
INFO Index Buffer 567 draws have ≤ 65535 indices — verify UINT16 index buffers are used 567 draws use small meshes (≤ 65535 indices) which could use 16-bit (UINT16) index buffers instead of 32-bit (UINT32). UINT16 halves index buffer memory and improves cache efficiency. Check your mesh export settings.
